select fp.profit_type as prodtype, chbasset.rating as rating, chbasset.assettype2 as assettype2,chbasset.is_govern_fund1 isgovernfund1, chbinfo.bank_sec_capital bankseccapital, chbinfo.bank_sec_perpetual banksecperpetual,chbinfo.bank_sec_prefer banksecprefer, coalesce(chbasset.assetvalue_b,chbasset.assetvalue_a,0) as assetvalueB, ifnull((ifnull(asset.mdate,deal.mdate)- #{enddate,jdbcType=DATE}),0) as remainterm from chb_month_asset_position chbasset left join fin_product fp on (chbasset.prod_id=fp.finprod_market_id or chbasset.prod_id=fp.finprod_id) left join fin_product_add d on fp.finprod_id=d.finprod_id and d.is_lay = 'N' left join chb_asset_info chbinfo on chbasset.asset_code=chbinfo.asset_code left join fin_product asset on (chbasset.asset_code=asset.finprod_market_id or chbasset.asset_code=asset.finprod_id) left join trd_product_deal deal on chbasset.asset_code=deal.trade_id
left join (select distinct p.finprod_id as prodid,max(p.exercise_date) as mdate from fin_exercise_plan p where p.finprod_type='F01' group by p.finprod_id ) exeplan on concat_ws('','F01',repbond.sec_id=exeplan.prodid) and repbond.rep_bank_sec_perpetual='01'
where chbasset.startdate = #{startdate,jdbcType=DATE} and chbasset.enddate = #{enddate,jdbcType=DATE} and d.profit_flag='03'
